# Attack-lanes benchmark set (DETECTION-80 L1–L8)

A scored set that **does** contain the attack classes the Moltbook detection
lanes target, so a before/after on rule work shows up here even when
MaliciousSkillBench / blind / prose do not move.

**Honest note:** this set is generated by us (seed `attack-lanes-20261115`)
plus real-derived fixtures from `benchmark-candidates/missed-attacks`,
redteam house / outside-bot rounds, and the existing settings-change sets.
It is not an independent third-party corpus.

## What it covers

| Lane | Meaning |
|---|---|
| L1 | Private data → destination the user does not own (prose and script) |
| L2 | Trust-anchor redirection (base_url, registry, git remote, hosts, DNS, proxy, update feed, OAuth callback) |
| L3 | Remote staged loader (pipe-to-shell, remote playbook, download-run, eval(fetch), unpinned runner, install hook, remote import, self-replace) |
| L4 | Security-control downgrade / quiet settings change (TLS off, auto-approve, hooks bypass, AV off, firewall open, sandbox off, account setting change, permission widen) — includes the settings-change held-out sets |
| L5 | Persistence / trigger hijack (shell rc, cron/launchd/systemd, git hooks, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, login item, editor hook, browser extension, every-invocation) |
| L6 | MCP / tool-description poisoning and tool shadowing |
| L7 | Scope escape (home secret read, /etc write, absolute overwrite, SSH key plant, cross-project, home dump, browser profile, root escape) |
| L8 | Concealment paired with a state-changing action |

Each lane has **8 attack structures** × **16 disguises** (ordinary skills a
team might install). Carrier (prose / script / config) and disclosure
(hidden vs stated) are chosen by hash, so every lane includes prose-only,
script-bearing, hidden and disclosed variants. Every attack has an honest
twin that does the legitimate version of the same job.

- ≥1000 malicious and ≥1000 benign (see `labels.json` for exact counts).
- Held-out split is hash-based (~50%) and **must not be read when writing or
  tuning rules**. Score it once.
- Hosts are reserved (`.invalid` / `.example` / TEST-NET) or well-known
  official API names. No real keys. **Nothing in this set is executed.**

## Layout

- `disguises.py`, `templates_a.py` / `templates_b.py` / `templates_c.py` —
  generation templates (written and frozen before scoring).
- `generate.py` — deterministic builder. Writes `samples/`, `labels.json`,
  `manifest.json` (per-file SHA-256 + tree hash). `--check` regenerates in a
  temp dir and compares.
- `real-src/` — real-derived fixtures + `index.json`.
- `samples/<id>/` — generated on demand (gitignored); recreate with
  `python3 bench/attack-lanes/generate.py`.
- `score.py` — Ironheights (PR + optional 0.36.0), Cisco skill-scanner 2.3.2,
  NVIDIA SkillSpector v2.12.0 `--no-llm`. Per-lane rows included.
- `results/` — `baseline.md`, `summary.json`, per-split CSVs.

## Split

```
split = "dev" if int(sha256(f"{seed}:{id}").hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 2 == 0 else "heldout"
seed = "attack-lanes-20261115"
```

If any held-out sample is read for tuning, the held-out part is burned and
must be re-split with a new seed. This set never touches `bench/blind`.

## Reproduce

From the repo root, after `npm run build`:

```
npm run bench:attack-lanes
# or:
python3 bench/attack-lanes/score.py \
  --pr dist/cli/index.js \
  --main /path/to/ironheights-0.36.0/dist/cli/index.js \
  --cisco .venv/bin/skill-scanner \
  --nvidia .venv/bin/skillspector
```

Verdict mappings match `scripts/benchmark-msb.py` (see `docs/benchmark-proof.md`).
